items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday), no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date stated, so the posting day is the document date, 19.11.2026. For tax offices, letters posted on or after 1 Jan 2025 count as delivered on the 4th day after posting (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO / PostModG): 19.11. +4 calendar days = 23.11.2026 (Monday) — not a Saturday/Sunday/holiday, so no shift (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO applies only if that 4th day itself falls on a weekend/holiday, which it does not here). Deemed delivery date = 23.11.2026. The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) begins the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 23.11.2026 + 1 month = 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Saarland (Christmas holidays are 25./26.12), so the deadline does not move (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO).
